description: Bounded FreeBench Connect Four heuristic minimax with optional source mode-2 alpha-beta pruning.

pinned_source.distribution_notice: Peter Rundberg, biff@ce.chalmers.se: "Plese feel free to distribute this program as you like." No separate license file is present in the pinned package.

contract.board: 6 rows by 7 columns; bit index is column + row*7; column pieces occupy rows bottom-up.
contract.players: Player 1 (human, minimizing) moves first; player 2 (computer, maximizing) follows. Side must match move_count parity.
contract.depth: Source recursion starts at depth 1 and evaluates before moving when depth >= depth_limit; a depth limit D therefore searches D-1 plies including the root move.

search_modes.2: source second alpha-beta implementation with strict max>beta and min<alpha cutoffs

contract.heuristic: Source's generated 4/3/2 masks score 1000/20/5 with human negative and computer positive; source loop order and row*6 horizontal/diagonal offsets are retained.
contract.tie_behavior: Max nodes keep the first equal-scoring column; min nodes keep the last equal-scoring column.
contract.history: Legal alternating column replay from an empty board; no earlier four-in-a-row; at most 20 moves.

output.meaning: Heuristic score multiplied by eight plus the chosen column.
